domain_setting: A candidate profile that shows the personal qualities, people skills, practical abilities, and planning strengths employers value at work.
recurring_scale_anchors: adult workers and candidates are busts centered near x=152, with heads around y=55..90
work counters, desks, team tables, and shared project surfaces sit around y=125..145, leaving floor visible below y=154
blank charts, icon-only tools, task cards, sample documents, schedules, and computer-like panels recur as work props
essential silhouettes stay within x=24..280 and y=16..176 on a 304x192 stage

polysemy_resolution_table.accurate / attention to detail: accurate means correct or precise; attention to detail shows a person carefully checking small parts before completion
polysemy_resolution_table.adaptability / adaptable / flexible: adaptability is the capacity to adjust, adaptable describes a person who adjusts well, and flexible shows willingness to change a plan; do not use the Japanese gloss's bendable-object sense
polysemy_resolution_table.ambitious / determined / motivated: ambitious aims for a significant future goal, determined persists through difficulty, and motivated is energized by a clear reason to act
polysemy_resolution_table.businesslike attitude / professional / p: businesslike attitude is calm, efficient workplace conduct; professional is a skilled worker behaving appropriately; professional attributes are a portfolio of work-ready qualities, not only credentials
polysemy_resolution_table.calm / patient (personality trait): calm stays composed in a stressful moment; patient waits and explains without rushing another person; patient means the personality trait, not a person receiving medical care
polysemy_resolution_table.competitive / ambitious: competitive strives to perform well against a benchmark or peers; ambitious pursues a larger personal goal
polysemy_resolution_table.confident / determined: confident trusts one's ability while acting; determined remains committed to finishing a difficult objective
polysemy_resolution_table.creative / innovative: creative generates original ideas; innovative turns a new idea into a useful improvement
polysemy_resolution_table.efficient / hardworking / energetic: efficient achieves results with little wasted effort; hardworking sustains effort; energetic brings high activity and enthusiasm
polysemy_resolution_table.fast learner / adaptable: a fast learner grasps new procedures quickly; an adaptable worker adjusts behavior when conditions change
polysemy_resolution_table.honest / reliable / responsible: honest tells the truth, reliable can be counted on to follow through, and responsible accepts duties and consequences
polysemy_resolution_table.independent / team player: independent can complete work without constant help; a team player contributes constructively to shared work
polysemy_resolution_table.organized / organization: organized describes a person who keeps tasks and materials in order; organization is the act or system of arranging work, not a company by default
polysemy_resolution_table.practical: uses workable real-world methods and useful hands-on judgment, not merely theoretical ideas
polysemy_resolution_table.punctual: arrives or completes work on time, shown without readable clock digits
polysemy_resolution_table.communication / fluent in (languages) /: communication conveys or receives a message; fluent in is effortless command of a language; public speaking addresses a live audience; telephone manner shows polite, clear conduct during a call
polysemy_resolution_table.customer service / customer-focused: customer service is the help given to a customer; customer-focused means the worker notices and prioritizes customer needs throughout the interaction
polysemy_resolution_table.interpersonal skills / teamwork / team p: interpersonal skills help someone relate well to others; teamwork is joint effort toward one outcome; team player describes an individual who contributes well to a group
polysemy_resolution_table.negotiating: the ongoing act of discussing terms toward an agreement, selected from working-with-others group rather than a stand-alone job-search skill label
polysemy_resolution_table.able to drive: a practical driving ability shown through a person safely controlling a road vehicle
polysemy_resolution_table.administration / computer skills / compu: administration is organized office support and record handling, computer skills are abilities operating a computer, computing is working with computer systems and software, and IT is the broader workplace technology setup and support
polysemy_resolution_table.data analysis / numeracy / research: data analysis finds patterns in collected information; numeracy is confident use of quantities and arithmetic; research gathers and checks information to answer a question
polysemy_resolution_table.decision-making / initiative / leadershi: decision-making selects among options; initiative starts useful action without waiting to be told; leadership guides people toward a shared result
polysemy_resolution_table.problem-solving / project management / t: problem-solving diagnoses and resolves an obstacle; project management coordinates a defined outcome and its tasks; time management plans priorities and available time
polysemy_resolution_table.organization / coordination: organization arranges tasks or materials into order; coordination aligns people, resources, and timing so parts work together
polysemy_resolution_table.responsible (personality trait) / respon: responsible describes a dependable quality of a person; responsible for means ownership of a specific assigned task or outcome

sibling_contrasts.personal qualities: accuracy checks correctness; reliability is follow-through; punctuality is timely arrival; flexibility and adaptability adjust to change; ambition, determination, and motivation express different goal energy; efficiency, hard work, and energy differ in resource use, persistence, and pace
sibling_contrasts.professional conduct: businesslike attitude shows measured workplace behavior; professional shows competent conduct; professional attributes gather qualities useful across work roles
sibling_contrasts.people skills: communication sends and receives messages; interpersonal skills support respectful relationships; teamwork is shared activity; team player is an individual role; customer service is direct help; customer-focused is a steady priority
sibling_contrasts.specialized abilities: language fluency and public speaking are distinct communication settings; telephone manner concerns voice etiquette; administration handles office processes; computer skills, computing, and IT refer to user capability, technical work, and workplace systems
sibling_contrasts.planning and judgment: numeracy works with quantities; data analysis interprets datasets; research gathers evidence; attention to detail catches small errors; decision-making selects a path; initiative starts action; problem-solving resolves obstacles; leadership guides people; project and time management organize scope and schedule
sibling_contrasts.lesson 42 responsibility contrast: responsible is a personal quality; responsible for names the particular duty one owns

art_direction: Editorial workplace skill scenes with warm paper, navy ink, blue work furniture, and restrained green or gold evidence marks. Use specific actions and contrasts to teach each quality. Keep every prop icon-only: no readable words, letters, numerals, logos, or real personal data.
